classification.difficultyReason: Select the dependent-variable boundary, solve the supplied linear equation backwards, then use the negative slope to interpret that boundary as a maximum.

content.prompt: The equation of the line of best fit connecting the water level ($W$), in metres, of a dam and the number of consecutive weeks without rain ($n$) is $W = -0.35n + 12.4$. Predict the most number of weeks without rain if you want the water level to be at least 8.9 m.

answer.worked:
Find the number of weeks when $W = 8.9$.
$$\begin{align*}8.9 &= -0.35n + 12.4\\-3.5 &= -0.35n\\n &= 10\end{align*}$$
The water level decreases as the number of weeks without rain increases, so the number of weeks must be at most this value for the predicted water level to be at least 8.9 m.
